items.title: The default config path moves from ~/.attentionrc to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/attention

change.citation: attention now reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/attention/config; ~/.attentionrc is read only as a fallback

config_status.detail: The repos still ship the old path and nothing here says what to do about it.

suggestions.title: Research attention's config path from the source, not the release notes
suggestions.method_topic: where attention's real config-path changes are announced
suggestions.method_note: attention moves its config path in ordinary commits and mentions it nowhere in the release body. Read the `config` package's diff across the range rather than the CHANGELOG, which said nothing about the 2.4.1 move.
suggestions.rationale: The 2.4.1 move was invisible in the release notes this review read first.
